verdict.rationale: An email marketing SaaS could plausibly offer full API parity with its UI, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a Moosend API at all, let alone parity with the UI. The only related item is "Connect all your apps... Zero coding required," which describes no-code integrations, an adjacent feature rather than API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
